description: This file contains unit tests for the CompanyStructureService class in the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing methods related to subunit retrieval, addition, deletion, and hierarchical chain computation within the administrative service layer.

classes.name: CompanyStructureServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the CompanyStructureService methods related to organizational subunits and hierarchy.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of CompanyStructureService, and populates test fixtures.

methods.name: testGetSubunitById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a Subunit object by ID using the service.

methods.name: testSaveSubunit
methods.description: Tests saving a Subunit object through the service layer.

methods.name: testAddSubunit
methods.description: Tests adding a new subunit to a parent subunit.

methods.name: testSetOrganizationName
methods.description: Tests setting the organization's name through the service.

methods.name: testGetSubunitTreeObject
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the entire subunit hierarchy as a tree structure.

methods.name: testGetSubunitChainById
methods.description: Complex test verifying the hierarchical chain of subunits by ID, including nested subunit creation and boundary checks.
